assumptions.statement: Official regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities, fire, flood, transport, and engineering conditions are not available in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, setbacks, capacity, parking, and construction feasibility remain unknown and are not claimed by this proposal.

assumptions.statement: The overall boundary and three key-area polygons are rough provisional geometries inferred from public text and announced areas.
assumptions.impact: All locations and areas are discussion-scale; every derived layer, metric, figure, and PDF must be regenerated after official polygons are released.

assumptions.statement: No complete rights-cleared building survey or heritage-control geometry is available.
assumptions.impact: The building footprint demonstrates a renovation-first method only; it does not identify a real demolition, retention, or construction parcel.

assumptions.statement: Seven personas and their needs are design hypotheses derived from inclusive-design principles and a Haidian lived-experience perspective, not survey results.
assumptions.impact: Voluntary interviews, accessibility walks, child-friendly observation, courier engagement, and merchant workshops are required before implementation.

assumptions.statement: The 100-day review cycle, data trustee, and 1+1+1 stewardship model are governance proposals without assigned agencies, budget, procurement, or approval.
assumptions.impact: They require public-sector, community, legal, accessibility, and procurement co-design before any trial.

assumptions.statement: The generated cover is a speculative design illustration and does not depict a surveyed or approved condition.
assumptions.impact: It is labelled and used only as a cover; spatial claims are carried by the provisional GeoJSON and programmatic diagrams.
